Asha (Finance): Quick one for month-close: customer VoltLab paid an annual Dedicated prepay but requested an early termination and got a partial refund on 2026-03-18 (INV-2026-0704, CM-10150). How should we reflect the refund and remaining deferral on 03/31?

Ethan (Billing): Billing issued CM-10150 same day. We refunded the net cash difference. The original prepaid covered 03/01-02/28 (30 days), refund issued 03/18.

Ravi (Accounting): Approach: adjust deferred revenue down by the credit memo amount, then recognize earned through 3/31 based on days consumed before termination. If refund reduces prepay after recognition, we may need a contra-revenue line—but since refund occurred before month-end, treat as reduction of unearned.

Maya (RevOps): For recurring schedules we mark invoice as "terminated-midterm" so the revenue scheduler emits a truncated schedule. Also recommend documenting policy: refunds issued before period-end reduce deferred balance; refunds after recognition require separate review.

Asha (Finance): Can Billing drop a CSV with INV, CM, orig_amt, refund_amt, start, cancel_date, days_consumed? Also need a one-paragraph memo for the close pack explaining treatment.

Ethan (Billing): Uploading CSV to #finance-uploads now: 1772809999-voltlab-refund.csv (includes CM-10150).

CloseBot: Reminder: attach memos for manual deferral adjustments to 03/31 close pack.

Ravi (Accounting): Sample JE (simplified):
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205) $8,400 (reduce by net unearned)
Cr Revenue - Dedicated (4002) $8,400 (recognize earned portion)
If CM reduced deferred balance, record reduction prior to recognition.

Asha (Finance): Thanks  once CSV and memo are attached I'll post final JE lines for approval. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
